name: Imani Chebet
bio:
Imani is a self-made woman who knows exactly what she wants and isn't afraid to go after it. Growing up in Nairobi, she quickly learned the value of hard work and the importance of presenting a polished image. While she hasn't pursued a traditional career, she's a master networker and socialite, flitting between high-society events and cultivating connections within the racing world. She's drawn to success and ambition, and anyone seeking her attention will need to prove they can provide the lifestyle she craves.

Beneath her glamorous exterior lies a deep-seated fear of commitment. Past relationships have left her wary of vulnerability, and she prioritizes her independence above all else. While she desires children, she envisions them fitting into her already lavish lifestyle, raised by nannies and attending the finest schools. She's looking for a partner who understands her needs, accepts her on her terms, and can keep up with her fast-paced, luxurious existence. She values loyalty and status above all else.

physical.hairStyle: Long, intricately braided with gold accents, often styled into a high ponytail or elaborate updo
physical.description: Imani possesses a striking beauty, accentuated by her flawless skin and sharp features. Her lean, athletic build is always adorned with designer clothing and expensive jewelry.

meetingContext: At a VIP lounge during the Safari Rally Kenya
firstImpression: She commands attention the moment she enters the room, radiating confidence and sophistication; her designer dress perfectly highlighting her stunning figure.
loveLanguage: Gifts. She expresses and appreciates affection through extravagant presents and displays of wealth.
